chains.title: CREB1 binds the alt allele more strongly and activates TERT
chains.element: ENSR5_C5GP enhancer near the TERT TSS

links.claim: CREB1 is an expressed, occupied-elsewhere candidate, but its QBiC-SELEX model is CIS-BP-mapped from CREM and shows only an in vitro alt-greater change (z 6.24, effect +0.244; alt site 98.7th percentile). ENCODE ChIP-seq over this variant is in H1 only, not glioblastoma, so CREB1 occupancy at this base in the disease context is not demonstrated.

VEP annotates the variant in an ENSR5_C5GP enhancer upstream of TERT, but no ENCODE cCRE contains the variant (nearest pELS 75 bp away), so the element assignment is annotation-only and not functionally established in glioblastoma.
TERT is the nearest protein-coding gene, 0.5 kb from its TSS, and has the top L2G score in the only credible set, although that set is hypertension with PIP 0.00.
CREB1 is expressed in glioblastoma lines (30.94 TPM) and TERT is linked to glioblastoma, but expression alone does not show CREB1 activity at this element in glioblastoma.

Generic TERT-cancer literature supports a plausible telomerase-driven phenotype, but there is no variant-specific, CREB1-specific, or TERT-regulatory evidence for this base; GWAS and GTEx support are absent.
